field_discovery_default.custom.field_discovery.filter: vsys_id in (1,2) and client_ip='192.168.0.1' AND server_port = 80

field_discovery_bytes.custom.field_discovery.filter: vsys_id in (1,2) and client_ip='192.168.0.1' AND server_port = 80

long_term.custom.long_term.sql: select client_ip, count(*) as count from session_record where vsys_id in (1,2) and client_ip='192.168.0.1' AND server_port = 80 group by client_ip order by count asc limit 10

report.custom.report.sql: SELECT log_id, recv_time FROM session_record LIMIT 12

statistics_top.custom.statistics.sql: select client_ip, count(*) as count from session_record where vsys_id in (1,2) and client_ip='192.168.0.1' AND server_port = 80 group by client_ip order by count desc limit 10
